cards.title: Act 1: Why Are We Down?
cards.description:
🚨 Checkout errors: 38%

Datin Sarah: "Why are we down?"
Find what changed, then roll it back.
cards.image_prompt: Red alert emergency in a modern e-commerce operations room at night: every monitor glowing red with crashing line graphs and red warning triangles, a red rotating alarm beacon on the ceiling, a stressed young engineer leaning toward the screens, a half-drunk glass of teh tarik beside the keyboard, generic night city lights through the window, isometric game art

cards.title: 💬 DevOps Agent
cards.description:
Finds the root cause by matching deploys, code changes and errors. It recommends the fix. You approve it.

🤖 "One release lines up with the errors. Ignore the noise."

cards.title: Culprit Found
cards.description: v4.2.0 cut the payment timeout from 3000 ms to 300 ms. Every payment now times out.

cards.title: Retry Storm
cards.description:
Instant retries turned a small spike into 10× the traffic.

🤖 "Roll back now. Add backoff after."

cards.title: Checkout Restored
cards.description:
Errors: 38% → 0.2% ✅

🤖 "One more thing. v4.2.0 was deployed with temp-hotfix-admin, a break-glass admin key that skips release review. Who else has that key?"

cards.title: ✅ Culprit Release
cards.description: v4.2.0: timeout 3000 → 300 ms

cards.title: ✅ Agent Findings
cards.description: Timeout + instant retries = retry storm

cards.title: Act 2: Were We Breached?
cards.description:
🔐 Login: 40,000 requests a minute

Datin Sarah: "Were we breached?"
Find out who has that key.
cards.image_prompt: Security breach scene: a large glowing padlock cracked open in the centre, a hooded shadowy intruder silhouette on a screen behind it, a swarm of small red bot icons streaming toward a login screen, a golden key glowing red on the desk, cool blue room with red warning light, isometric game art

cards.title: 💬 Security Agent
cards.description:
AWS Security Agent (now part of AWS Continuum) finds risks in code and designs before launch: reviews, threat models, pen tests.

🤖 "I flagged that key three weeks ago, as Finding 3. Your team waived it as 'temporary'."

cards.title: 📋 Pre-launch Review, 3 weeks ago
cards.description:
Finding 1: SQL injection, fixed
Finding 2: leaking error pages, fixed
Finding 3: admin key hard-coded in the deploy script, no MFA. CRITICAL. WAIVED

Tonight's botnet on the login page is noise. WAF and GuardDuty are handling it.

cards.title: Roles Mapped
cards.description: Security Agent works before launch. GuardDuty and WAF work at runtime.

cards.title: The Predicted Path
cards.description: The agent mapped this path for Finding 3. CloudTrail shows it really happened.

cards.title: Breach Contained
cards.description:
Key revoked. Role deleted. Bots still blocked at the WAF.

🛡️ No more waivers on CRITICAL findings.

📱 Finance: "WHY ARE WE AT RM 48,000 SINCE FRIDAY??"

cards.title: ✅ Security Roles
cards.description: Before launch: Security Agent. At runtime: GuardDuty, WAF.

cards.title: ✅ Attack Path
cards.description: Key in script → public repo → attacker → admin → instances

cards.title: Act 3: What Is It Costing Us?
cards.description:
💸 Spend since Friday: RM 48,000

Datin Sarah: "What is this costing us?"
Trace every line of the bill.
cards.image_prompt: Cloud cost dashboard on a large curved monitor with one steep red cost line shooting upward, three highlighted cost bars, a world map with one unexpected region glowing red, stacks of gold coins on the desk, dark ops room with orange and teal light, isometric game art

cards.title: 💬 FinOps Agent (Preview)
cards.description:
Explains cost spikes by checking CloudTrail, and names the owner. It reports. It doesn't switch anything off.

🤖 "Since Friday, USD 10,800. The biggest line was launched with temp-hotfix-admin."

cards.title: Costs Traced
cards.description: The leaked key ran GPUs. Friday's load test was never switched off.

cards.title: Bleeding Stopped
cards.description:
The agent flagged it at 07:12 this morning, in a channel nobody owns. Now the owners have it and the spend is off.

🛡️ Findings go straight to the owner.

🤖 "One key, three alarms. The CEO is back."

cards.title: ✅ Cost Map
cards.description: GPUs → leaked key. Fleet + logs → Friday's test.

cards.title: Finale: Answer the CEO
cards.description:
⏰ 11:52 PM. Eight minutes to the sale.

Add the guardrails, then answer the CEO.
cards.image_prompt: Over-the-shoulder view from behind an engineer at a desk, looking at one large monitor that shows a video call with a composed Malaysian businesswoman in a blazer, framed head and shoulders like a webcam picture, three small round green indicator lamps glowing on the desk, dark ops room, calm teal light, isometric game art

cards.title: 💬 Datin Sarah
cards.description:
"Tell me what we'll fix. Then tell me straight: were we breached?"

Remember: the bots were never the real story.

cards.title: One Shortcut, Three Alarms
cards.description: One break-glass key took down checkout, let an attacker in, and ran up the bill. The agents flagged every part. Now someone acts on what they find.

cards.title: ✅ The Whole Story
cards.description: One key: outage, breach and bill.

cards.title: 11.11 is LIVE 🎉
cards.description:
00:00. Checkout holding. You told the CEO the truth.

🤖 DevOps Agent found why you were down.
🤖 Security Agent flagged the key weeks before.
🤖 FinOps Agent traced the bill to its owner.

Real world: Western Governors University went from about 2 hours to 28 minutes per incident with DevOps Agent. HENNGE cut pen-test time by more than 90% with Security Agent.

👋 See the agents live with the Enterprise Support team at this booth.
